description: Extends a hosted zone, secondary zone or dynamic hostname by 30d or 1y from its current expiry. Needs no token: anyone may pay to extend any name. Paid, no account. Without payment the call returns payment_required with the price, a Lightning invoice and a Cashu payment request; pay only within what your user allowed, then call again with the same arguments plus l402='<macaroon>:<preimage>', or call with cashu='<token>'. Every request is checked for free before an invoice is made; use check first.

cashu.description: Cashu token (cashuA... or cashuB...) worth at least the price, from an accepted mint (see info). Pays without a previous call.

l402.description: Lightning payment proof for a retry: '<macaroon>:<preimage>', where macaroon comes from the payment_required answer of the previous call and preimage is the 64-hex proof your wallet returns after paying its invoice. Use it with the same tool and arguments.

name.description: The hosted zone (example.com) or the dynamic hostname (myhome.dynkite.com).

period.description: 30d (30 days) or 1y (365 days). Prices differ: see the tool title.

name: renew
title: Renew a zone (500 / 5,000 sats) or hostname (200 / 2,000 sats)
